items.note: Activity 4 (Raise your own exceptions, #activity-4) now carries a required authoring task in the inventory.py lesson editor (fieldset #exed, goal "author", the only check for step 4). Its starter supplies the logging import, module logger, OutOfStock class and a try/if stock check with a placeholder; to pass, the learner must write a raise of the custom exception with a non-empty message at the placeholder, then add except OutOfStock, else and finally blocks aligned with try, each with its logger call, including logger.exception inside the handler. This covers o1 (try/except/else/finally with a specific exception), o2 (raise a custom exception with a message) and o3 (module logger, logger.exception for a caught exception) as construction rather than recognition; Problems and Output give scaffold-scoped diagnostics, matching the recommendation. Activities 2 and 3 remain trace/explore activities as supporting practice. Gating verified by static read of the inline runtime (TOPIC.need step 4 = author; settle() applies only to apply; timeline links and popstate are capped at the unlocked step) and a JS-enabled Chromium run: the activity-4 timeline link and an #activity-4 hash/popstate both leave the learner on activity 1, Continue stays hidden, and running the untouched starter (and a variant with every placeholder replaced by pass) leaves data-pep-completed=false.
